data.title: What we store
data.account: Your account: e-mail address, name, language, and your password as a hash (never the password itself).
data.sessions: Logins: when you logged in and last used the app, and which browser and system. Not your IP address.
data.content: What you enter: inventory, purchases and shops, budget, shopping list, meal plan, waste and barcodes you have scanned.
data.allergies: Allergies, if you choose to enter them. They may count as health data. They are used only to hide or warn about recipes, and others see them only if you turn on sharing with the household (without your name).
data.receipts: Photos of receipts: only until you have confirmed or discarded the purchase, and never more than 7 days.
data.household: In a shared household the other members see the household's data and your name.

purpose.title: Why
purpose.text: We use the data only to give you what the app does: keeping track of food, purchases and budget, suggesting recipes and sharing with your household. No advertising, no profiling and no selling of data.
purpose.basis: The legal basis for allergies (special categories, GDPR Article 9) has not been finally assessed by the team yet.

recipients.title: Who gets anything
recipients.off: Open Food Facts gets the barcode you scan, from our server, not from your phone.
recipients.kassalapp: Kassalapp gets the barcode, only if price lookups are switched on.
recipients.hibp: Have I Been Pwned gets the first 5 characters of a hash of a new password, so we can refuse passwords from known data breaches. Nobody can find the password from that.
recipients.mail: Google (Gmail) gets your e-mail address, your name and the content of the e-mail when you ask for a new password, because the e-mail is sent from a Gmail account. We have no data processing agreement with Google; that is accepted for the test environment only.
recipients.host: The server is in Germany (EEA), with a provider that runs the machine.
recipients.none: We use no analytics, tracking or ad networks.

retention.title: For how long
retention.account: Your account and what you have entered: until you delete the account.
retention.sessions: Logins: expire after 14 days without use and at the latest after 30 days, and are deleted every night.
retention.receipts: Receipt photos and the text read from them: until the purchase is confirmed or discarded, at most 7 days.
retention.backups: Backups: every night, encrypted, the last 7 days. Something you have deleted may therefore remain in a copy for up to 7 days. Receipt photos are never included.
retention.logs: The server's log: what kind of request and when, without e-mail, name, IP address or what you have entered.
retention.resetLinks: Links for a new password: work for 30 minutes, only a hash is stored, and they are deleted after a day.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.access: Access and a copy: “Download my data” on your profile gives you everything in one file.
rights.rectify: Rectification: you can change most things yourself in the app.
rights.erase: Erasure: “Delete account” on your profile deletes the account and households where you are alone, at once.
rights.portability: Data portability: the file from “Download my data” is in a common, machine-readable format (JSON).
rights.withdraw: Withdrawal: you can remove your allergies and turn off sharing at any time.
rights.complain: Complaints: you can complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (datatilsynet.no).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: SmartMat uses only one cookie: the one that keeps you logged in. It holds a random number, not information about you.

toast.stocked_other: {{count}} items were added to the inventory.
toast.fromRecipe: Added to the shopping list: {{created}} new, {{merged}} merged with lines already there.
toast.fromRecipeNothing: Everything was already on the shopping list.

clear.title: Remove ticked lines?
clear.text_one: {{count}} ticked line will be removed from the list. It is not added to the inventory.
clear.text_other: {{count}} ticked lines will be removed from the list. They are not added to the inventory.

stock.title: Add to inventory
stock.description: Check the item, amount, place and date for each item before saving.
stock.notPurchase: The items are not recorded as a purchase and do not count towards the budget.
stock.name: Name of the new item

recipe.button: Add missing to the shopping list
recipe.title: Add to the shopping list
recipe.description: The ticked items are added to the shopping list. You can change the amounts.

reasons.unknownAmount: You have some, but the amount cannot be compared
reasons.staple: Staple – check that you have it

recipe.nothing: You have everything the recipe needs.

camera.title: Scan with the camera
camera.privacy: The camera picture stays on your device. Only the numbers in the barcode are sent.
camera.scanning: Hold the barcode inside the frame.
camera.typeInstead: You can type the barcode instead.

insecure.title: The camera needs a secure page
insecure.text: Browsers only allow the camera on pages opened with https (or on localhost).

unsupported.title: This browser does not support the camera
unsupported.text: This browser does not give web pages access to the camera.

denied.title: No access to the camera
denied.text: You or the browser said no to the camera. You can allow it in the browser's settings for this page.

noCamera.title: No camera found
noCamera.text: We found no camera on this device, or another app is using it.

failed.title: The camera did not start
failed.text: Something went wrong when starting the camera or the barcode reader.

manual.title: Type the barcode
manual.label: Barcode
manual.hint: The numbers under the bars, usually 13 or 8 digits.

status.found: Found in Open Food Facts. Check and correct before adding.
status.household: You have scanned this before. Last time's answers are filled in.
status.notFound: We did not find this barcode. Fill it in yourself, and we will remember it next time.
status.unavailable: The product lookup is not answering right now. Fill it in yourself.
status.storeCode: The store's own code (for example for weight or price). Fill it in yourself. The code is not remembered.
status.off: Product lookup is not switched on in this version of SmartMat. Fill in the form yourself.
status.receiptCode: This is the barcode on a receipt or coupon, not on a product.

form.title: Check and add to the pantry
form.nameHint: Correct the name if it is wrong or in another language.
form.ingredientAmbiguous: Automatic (the name fits several, not linked)
form.dateHint: The date is never filled in. Read it on the pack.

scan.added: {{name}} has been added to the pantry.

receipts.title: Receipt
receipts.lead: Take a photo of the receipt and we fill in the purchase. You check and correct it before anything is saved.

upload.title: Upload a receipt
upload.lead: Lay the receipt flat, in good light, and get all of it in the picture.
upload.privacy: The image is only processed on our server. Location and other camera information are removed. The image is deleted when you confirm the purchase, or after 7 days.

camera.hint: Get the whole receipt in the picture, and hold the phone still when you press.
camera.fallbackText: You can use the phone's camera app or choose a file instead.

unavailable.title: Receipt reading is not available
unavailable.text: It is not set up on this server. You can enter the purchase yourself.

waiting.queued: The receipt is in the queue …
waiting.text: It usually takes a few seconds. You can stay on this page.
waiting.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can wait, or enter the purchase yourself.

failed.title: The receipt could not be read
failed.unavailable: Receipt reading is not responding right now.
failed.noText: We found no text in the image. Try a sharper photo of the whole receipt in good light.
failed.retryFailed: Could not try again. Reload the page.

review.title: Check the receipt
review.lead: Look over what we read and correct anything that is wrong. Nothing is saved until you press "Confirm purchase".
review.openImage: Open the image in full size
review.lowConfidence: The image was hard to read. Check every field carefully.
review.dateGuessed: We could not find the date. Today’s date is filled in – check it.
review.storeGuessed: We could not find the store name on the receipt. It looks like receipts from {{store}}, where you shopped last, so that is filled in. Correct it if it is wrong.
review.totalOnly: We fill in the store, date and total. The lines are not read well enough yet. To put the items in your food stock, choose "With lines" and add them yourself.
review.sumMismatch: The lines add up to {{lines}}, but the receipt says {{total}}. Check the amounts.
review.savedWithItems_one: The purchase is saved and {{count}} item was added to your food stock.
review.savedWithItems_other: The purchase is saved and {{count}} items were added to your food stock.
review.allowDuplicate: Save anyway – this is a different purchase
review.allowDuplicateHint: Tick this if you shopped for the same amount on the same day.

flags.amountFromQuantity: the amount is worked out from count and price.
flags.quantityMismatch: count × price did not match the amount.

confirmed.title: The receipt is saved
confirmed.text: The purchase is saved and the image is deleted.

notFound.title: Receipt not found
notFound.text: It may have been discarded, or deleted because it was not confirmed within 7 days.

discard.title: Discard the receipt?
discard.text: The image and what we read are deleted. No purchase is saved.
discard.failed: Could not discard the receipt. Try again.

mealPlan.lead: Plan the week, see what is missing, and put it on the shopping list.
mealPlan.emptyWeek: Nothing is planned this week. Press plus under a day to add a recipe or a note.
mealPlan.hiddenMeals: The week also has breakfast or lunch. Tick “Show breakfast and lunch” to see them.
mealPlan.removeFailed: Could not remove it. Try again.

add.title: {{meal}}, {{day}}
add.what: What do you want to add?
add.noRecipes: No recipes yet. You can write a note instead.
add.rankedFor: Best fit first, based on what you have that can be used that day.
add.noteHint: For example “Leftovers” or “Eating out”. At most 100 characters.

needs.title: What the week needs
needs.weekOver: This week is over. Needs are only worked out for days to come.
needs.noRecipes: Add recipes to the plan to see here what is missing.
needs.period: Worked out from {{from}} to {{to}}. Days that are over do not count.
needs.allCovered: You have what the plan needs, or it is on the shopping list.
needs.intro: Tick what you want to buy. Nothing goes on the shopping list until you press the button.

reasons.unknownAmount: You have some, but the amount cannot be compared
reasons.staple: Staple – check that you have it
reasons.onList: Already added to the shopping list from the plan

needs.added: Added to the shopping list: {{created}} new lines, {{merged}} merged with lines already there.
needs.addedNothing: Nothing new to add. It is already on the shopping list.
needs.unplannedText: No recipe in the plan uses these. Something to cook with?

household.lost: You are no longer a member of {{name}}.
household.lostUnknown: You are no longer a member of the household you were viewing.

switcher.title: Your households
switcher.text: You are in more than one household. Pages show and save data in the active one.

members.title: Members
members.aloneTitle: You are alone in the household
members.aloneText: Invite the people you live with, and you will share inventory, purchases, budget, shopping list and meal plan.
members.removeText: {{name}} loses access to the household at once. What {{name}} has added stays.
members.removed: {{name}} has been removed from the household.

invite.title: Invite
invite.text: Make a link and send it to the person you want to invite, for example in a message. The link works once and for 48 hours.
invite.createdText: The link is shown only now. Send it to one person. It works until {{time}}.
invite.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link in the field and copy it yourself.
invite.ownerOnly: Only the owner can invite new members.

leave.title: Leave the household
leave.text: You lose access to the inventory, purchases, shopping list and meal plan here. What you have added stays in the household.
leave.ownerText: As the owner you must give ownership to another member before you can leave the household.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.text: The new owner can invite, remove members and delete the household. You become an ordinary member.
transfer.noMembers: There are no other members to transfer to.

delete.title: Delete the household
delete.text: Everything in the household is deleted for all members: inventory, purchases, budget, shopping list, meal plan and receipts. This cannot be undone. Everyone keeps their account, and anyone without another household gets a new, empty one.
delete.confirm: I understand that everything in the household is deleted for everyone

join.title: Join a household
join.missing: There is no invitation in the link. Open the link you got, or paste it here.
join.loggedOut: Log in or create an account to see the invitation and join.
join.ownData: What you have in your own household stays there. Nothing is merged or deleted. You can switch between the households under Household.
join.alreadyMember: You are already a member of “{{household}}”.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: What needs attention in the household right now.
notifications.emptyText: You get a notification here when an item is close to its date, when the budget is nearly used, or when others add to the shopping list.
notifications.dismissFailed: Could not dismiss the notification. Try again.

kinds.useByPassed: The use-by date of {{name}} has passed
kinds.budgetNearlyUsed: {{percent}} % of the food budget for {{month}} is used
kinds.budgetExceeded: The food budget for {{month}} is used up ({{percent}} %)

advice.useBySoon: A use-by date is about food safety. Use it before the date.
advice.useByToday: After today it should not be eaten.
advice.useByPassed: Should not be eaten. A use-by date is about food safety.
advice.bestBefore: Often still good after the date. Look, smell and taste.
advice.shopping: Open the shopping list to see everything.

waste.lead: What the household throws away, how much and why.
waste.emptyText: When something is thrown away from the inventory with “Throw away”, it shows up here with reason and value.
waste.valueSplit: {{actual}} are amounts you entered, and {{estimated}} is estimated from the item’s price.
waste.estimatedShare: {{percent}} % of the known value is estimated.
waste.estimatedShareBelowOne: Less than 1 % of the known value is estimated.
waste.unknown_one: {{count}} has an unknown value and is not in the sum.
waste.unknown_other: {{count}} have an unknown value and are not in the sum.
waste.shareNote: The share is of the number of discards, as the value can be missing.
waste.trendCaption: Thrown away per month. The bar shows the known value: solid for amounts you entered, hatched for estimated.

about.value: The value is either the amount you entered when throwing it away, or estimated from the item’s price. Discards without a price are counted but get no value.
about.undo: An undone discard does not count. Deleting an item also removes its discards.
about.category: The category is the one the item has now.
about.household: The figures are for the whole household. There are no figures per person.

prices.title: Prices
prices.estimateNote: The prices are for information only. What you pay, you record as a purchase.

own.title: What you have paid
own.emptyNoItem: You have not added this barcode to the inventory before, so there are no own prices for it.
own.empty: You have not recorded a price for this item yet. It comes with a purchase, or when you enter a price on a batch.

external.title: Prices at the chains

status.off: Prices from the chains are switched off. Only what you have paid is shown.
status.notAsked: A store’s own code cannot be looked up at the chains.
status.noBarcode: The item has not been scanned, so we cannot fetch prices from the chains. Scan it next time you buy it.
status.notFound: Kassalapp has no prices for this barcode.
status.unavailable: The price lookup is not answering right now. Try again later.
status.unavailableStored: The price lookup is not answering right now. The prices below were fetched {{date}} and may be out of date.
status.noPrices: No chain has a price for this item.
status.noFresh: No chain has checked the price in the last 14 days.

external.cheapestOf_one: Only {{count}} chain has a price checked in the last 14 days.
external.cheapestOf_other: Lowest of {{count}} chains with a price checked in the last 14 days.
external.caption: Latest price per chain, cheapest first
external.olderNote: Prices not checked for 14 days, and chains Kassalapp no longer collects prices from. They may be wrong today.
external.uncollected: Kassalapp no longer collects prices from this chain
external.coverage: The prices are for the chain, not a particular shop. Offers and member prices are not included, and Rema 1000, Kiwi and Coop are not included. This is not a complete comparison.

estimate.title: Estimated price
estimate.error: Could not work out the estimate.
estimate.missing_one: {{count}} line has no price and is not included.
estimate.missing_other: {{count}} lines have no price and are not included.
estimate.sources: From what you have paid: {{own}}. From Kassalapp: {{kassalapp}}.
estimate.none: None of the lines has a price yet. An estimate comes from what you have paid for the same item, or from Kassalapp once the item has been scanned.
estimate.note: An estimate, not what you will pay. It is not part of the budget.

missingReason.noMatch: no item in the inventory with this name
missingReason.unitMismatch: a different unit from the price

sessions.title: Where you are logged in
sessions.text: These are the browsers logged in to your account. We store only the browser and the system, not where you are or your IP address. If you do not recognise a login, log it out and change your password.
sessions.ended: The device has been logged out.
sessions.endedOthers_one: {{count}} other device has been logged out.
sessions.endedOthers_other: {{count}} other devices have been logged out.

loginNotice.title: New login to your account.
loginNotice.review: Not you? See where you are logged in

export.title: Download your data
export.text: You get a file (JSON) with what SmartMat has stored about you: your account, allergies, logins and everything in the households you are in. Passwords and receipt photos are not included.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor login
twoFactor.off: Off. With two-factor login you need both your password and a code from an app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password).
twoFactor.on_one: On. You have {{count}} unused recovery code.
twoFactor.on_other: On. You have {{count}} unused recovery codes.
twoFactor.unavailable: Two-factor login is not available on this server.

scan.app: Open the authenticator app and add a new account.
scan.key: Enter this key (upper or lower case, without spaces):
scan.open: Or open it directly in the app on this phone
scan.code: Enter the code the app shows for SmartMat.
scan.codeHint: 6 digits. The code changes every 30 seconds.

codes.title: Keep the recovery codes
codes.text: Each code can be used once if you lose your phone. Write them down or save them in a password manager. They are shown only now.

confirm.disable: Enter your password and a code to turn off two-factor login.
confirm.newCodes: Enter your password and a code. The old recovery codes stop working.
